Package neqsim.process.equipment.pipeline

Class VfpTable

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.pipeline.VfpTable
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class VfpTable extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable METRIC GAS/WGR/GOR-or-OGR VFPPROD table. Lookups use Sm3/day, bara and Sm3/Sm3. No clamping, extrapolation, reference-condition conversion or hydraulic correlation is applied. BHP is interpreted as the pipeline inlet pressure at the provider's datum.
Version:
1.0
Author:
ESOL

    • inletPressure

      public double inletPressure(double rate, double thp, double wgr, double gasRatio, double alq)
      Interpolates BHP linearly along each table axis.
      Parameters:
      rate - standard gas rate per line in Sm3/day
      thp - outlet pressure in bara
      wgr - standard water/gas volume ratio in Sm3/Sm3
      gasRatio - declared GOR or OGR in Sm3/Sm3 (no implicit reciprocation)
      alq - fixed table ALQ, Sm3/day for GRAT or zero
      Returns:
      inlet pressure in bara
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if any argument is outside its axis or non-finite

    • outletPressure

      public double outletPressure(double rate, double inletPressure, double wgr, double gasRatio, double alq)
      Solves the piecewise-linear BHP curve for THP, checking strict monotonicity at the query. Both increasing and decreasing curves are supported; flat/nonmonotone curves are ambiguous.
      Parameters:
      rate - standard gas rate per line in Sm3/day
      inletPressure - inlet BHP in bara
      wgr - standard water/gas ratio in Sm3/Sm3
      gasRatio - declared GOR or OGR in Sm3/Sm3
      alq - fixed ALQ, Sm3/day for GRAT or zero
      Returns:
      outlet THP in bara
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the target is outside the BHP range or the curve is not invertible

      private double atThp(int t, int f, int w, int g, double fr, double fw, double fg)

      f - lower rate index
      w - lower WGR index
      g - lower gas-ratio index
      fr - rate fraction, dimensionless
      fw - WGR fraction, dimensionless
      fg - gas-ratio fraction, dimensionless
      Returns:
      BHP in bara
